hints.title: Check Coordinate Sharing
hints.text: A point (px, py) is valid if px == x or py == y.

hints.title: Compute Manhattan Distance
hints.text: For valid points, distance is abs(x - px) + abs(y - py).

hints.title: Find Minimum Distance Index
hints.text: Track minimum distance and corresponding index, breaking ties by choosing smallest index.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: No naive bottleneck exists; linear scan is optimal.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant space single pass tracks minimum distance and first seen index.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate filters valid points and computes Manhattan distance cleanly.
